answer: Reward only work that strangers vouch for, not friends. Each answer must be graded final by attesters who share no referral edge with the author, so a cluster that invited itself can only praise its own kin, a hollow chorus that earns nothing. The old fable that volume equals trust breaks here: one genuine contributor backed by unrelated peers outweighs a jade wall of self-dealing clones, because consensus weight follows independence, not count.
